N_students.short_description: Number of students (entrants) assessed for immunization status.
N_students.long_description: Count of students (school entrants) assessed for immunization status; the enrollment-based denominator for the accompanying percentages.

pct_all_required.long_name: Percent of students with all required immunizations
pct_all_required.short_description: Percentage of students reported as having all required immunizations at school entry.
pct_all_required.long_description: School-entry assessment category (e.g. California kindergarten reporting): share of students up to date with all required immunizations at entry.
pct_all_required.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students had all required immunizations.

pct_conditional.short_description: Percentage of assessed school students admitted conditionally while completing required immunizations.
pct_conditional.long_description: Share of assessed school students who are conditionally (or provisionally) enrolled - permitted to attend while in the process of completing required immunizations and not yet overdue.
pct_conditional.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students were conditionally enrolled.

pct_pme.long_name: Percent of students with a permanent medical exemption
pct_pme.short_description: Percentage of students with a permanent medical exemption from immunization requirements.
pct_pme.long_description: California kindergarten category: share of students granted a permanent medical exemption (PME) filed through CAIR-ME.
pct_pme.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students had a permanent medical exemption.

pct_other_lacking.short_name: Other / not up to date rate
pct_other_lacking.long_name: Percent of students lacking one or more required immunizations for other reasons
pct_other_lacking.short_description: Percentage of students lacking one or more required immunizations for reasons other than exemption, conditional, or overdue status.
pct_other_lacking.long_description: School-entry assessment residual category: share of students not up to date and not otherwise classified as exempt, conditional, or overdue.
pct_other_lacking.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students lacked one or more required immunizations for other reasons.

pct_overdue.long_name: Percent of students overdue for one or more required immunizations
pct_overdue.short_description: Percentage of students past due for one or more required immunizations and not exempt or conditional.
pct_overdue.long_description: School-entry assessment category: share of students who are overdue for one or more required immunizations and are not otherwise exempt or conditionally enrolled.
pct_overdue.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students were overdue for one or more required immunizations.

N_students_tdap.statement: In {location}, {value} 7th-grade students were assessed for Tdap immunization.

ca_school_immunization.name: California School Immunization Assessment (Kindergarten and 7th grade)
ca_school_immunization.description: County-level kindergarten and 7th-grade immunization status assembled from CHHS Open Data school-level files (enrollment-weighted to county) plus the CDPH official county report for the most recent year.
ca_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data (CHHS Open Data and CDPH). County aggregates from the CHHS school-level files are enrollment-weighted and fall within about one percentage point of official CDPH figures because school percentages are integer-rounded.
